issue_context.title: Add latency metrics for scheduler framework permit "wait" behavior
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please only use this template for submitting enhancement requests -->

**What would you like to be added**:

metric name | metric definition | Description
-- | -- | --
permit_wait_duration_seconds | Type: Histogram Labels:result={“scheduled”, “timedout”, “unschedulable”, “error”} | Duration of permit extension point finishes waiting.

**Why is this needed**:
In permit extension point, if the status is "Wait", we block until the pod is scheduled or timeout:
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/dc0013a506d50c54d5a5833e92d82fce61301c2e/pkg/scheduler/framework/v1alpha1/framework.go#L563-L588

Blocking is an important behavior that we should monitor.

/sig scheduling

review_comments:
I think it is ok for time.AfterFunc to execute before newWaitingPod finishes, because when `newWaitingPod` is called, it means that permit plugins has been running and we could start timer for them. 

Is there any other concern?
Yes this causes race. In time.AfterFunc,  `wp.Reject` is called, which needs to iterate through the map. I ran into that in tests.
